primary.rule: Fetch and audit this exact known snapshot first. A newer snapshot requires a new immutable source lock and split audit before fitting.

optional.reason: No live source card, immutable revision, or overlap audit obtained.

extended.rule: Separate catalog, labels, calibration and coverage; no automatic benchmark/profile detection.

data_policy.reference_labels: Keep publisher labels for official scoring. Store strict phrase-contract labels independently and disclose disagreement.
data_policy.split_unit: connected component of speaker identity, exact PCM, near-duplicate/clean-noisy family and derived source_files parents
data_policy.development: Only publisher train groups, stratified by intent and provenance; train/dev/calibration/confirmation are disjoint.
data_policy.test: Published test and holdout untouched; repeated benchmarks, not pristine discovery sets.
data_policy.normalization: Frozen statistics fitted on eligible training humans only; shared frontend for all arms.
data_policy.missing_pronunciations: Mask CTC loss, do not discard valid command-labeled examples solely for missing phone targets.
data_policy.numerals: Auxiliary phone/number training only; never semantic commands or automatic OOS negatives.

candidate_order.treatment: frozen reference only, no retraining claimed; profile-restricted scoring gets new calibration

candidate_order.role: only if A1/A2 fail, fixed objective-vs-encoder control; NOT implemented in this audit

fit_protocol.sampling: 16 human strict positives, 8 publisher synthetic strict positives, 8 allowed train OOS; balance positives by semantic outcome; keep provenance quotas explicit. No holdout borrowing if a pool is empty.
fit_protocol.ctc_aux_rule: Only after direct arm; verified phone targets; mask unknown targets and check post-stride CTC feasibility. Numerals max 12.5% in a separate declared batch plan.
fit_protocol.augmentation_initial: none beyond publisher supplied material; dropout is model regularization
fit_protocol.selection: Human macro exact-command recall on dev subject to dev OOS constraints; then worst-intent recall; then lower measured single-core ONNX cost; then smaller model. Never pooled synthetic-dominated accuracy.
fit_protocol.matched_comparison: A1 vs A2 identical data, sampler, head losses and seeds. A0 vs A1 is not a causal backbone-only comparison.

calibration.method: temperature scalar for direct logits plus fixed OOS/margin threshold search on calibration only
calibration.ctc_reference: Recalibrate catalog/profile changes. Compare utterance duration/speech occupancy and explicit OOS competitor; do not treat score/T as calibrated confidence.

proposed_gates.note: Project proposal, not an asserted class rubric. Insufficient independent evidence is NOT a pass. Per-clip CIs are descriptive where voices/parents are correlated; also compute clustered intervals.

targets: strict OOS near-misses from allowed training text

forbidden: use old bootstrap profiles pulling other datasets
pretrained WavLM dependency for strict training
represent random-tensor timing as ONNX/Pi/speech evidence
